scientific_integrity: The statement is supported by an explicit analytical proof. Finite exact-rational and floating-point checks supplement, but do not prove, the infinite-time assertions. The first-public-source date comes from the original arXiv posting. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Global no-geometric-rate conclusion assumes finite fixed strong connectivity, a common strict upper response factor and vanishing response ratio on every relevant directed edge.
The exact three-term gap and tolerance-time law apply to the stated symmetric two-agent flat bias, not arbitrary graph geometries.
An unconstrained broader nonlinear-iteration literature may have overlapping analytic asymptotics.
title: Vanishing-response opinion biases: subgeometric consensus and exact logarithmic accuracy laws
